meta.description: Guess the hidden word in 6 tries (or less). A new puzzle is available each day!

text.no_attempts: You haven't tried any words yet!
text.notification-share-unsupported: Sorry, your browser doesn't support sharing. Please copy the text and share it yourself.
text.demo_intro: For the Casa 24 team: the same game, with buttons to restart with another word and to fill in the word. Doesn't count in your stats.
text.lb_privacy: Discord handles your login; we never see your password or email. We store your Discord ID, username and profile picture and your results to show the ranking and who is playing today. Other players see only your colors, never your words.
text.lb_guest_note: Guest games don't count toward the ranking.
text.lb_login_failed: Couldn't sign in with Discord. Please try again.
text.lb_deleted: Done: your leaderboard data was deleted.
text.lb_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
text.lb_hint: Play for the leaderboard to join the ranking
text.lb_guest_sync: Sign in with Discord to continue this game on Discord and count it toward the ranking.
text.lb_delete_confirm: Delete all your leaderboard data? This can't be undone.
text.lb_avatar_note: Other players see your Discord picture in the list of who is playing today.
text.lb_live_empty: No one else is playing right now

help.title: How to Play
help.text_1_2: Each guess must be a valid five letter word. Press the enter button to submit your guess.
help.text_1_3: After you guess, the tiles will change color to indicate which letters of your word are correct or almost correct.
help.text_2_1: is in the word and in the correct location!
help.text_2_2: is in the word, but not in the correct location.
help.text_2_3: is not present in the word you are trying to guess.
